description: This source file implements a utility program that interacts with POSIX message queues to send a 'leak_check' message to a queue named based on a process ID provided by the user. It defines message queue attributes, opens the queue, sends a message, and then closes the queue.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program that prompts for a process ID, constructs a message queue name, opens the queue, sends a 'leak_check' message, and closes the queue.
